title: When An Unknown Entity Watches Your House At 3 AM... 💀
description: Beluga helps Egg reach 10 Million subscribers at 3:14 AM... but the stream gets hijacked by an entity inside Beluga's house. #beluga #discord #horror #comedy

messages.content: it is literally 3:14 in the morning go to sleep

messages.content: LOOK AT MY YOUTUBE CHANNEL RIGHT NOW
